decisions: C0 computes CE without teacher use; C1-C6 share 0.5 CE + 0.5 exact full-vocabulary T=2 KD, with one T-squared factor and explicit inactive fields.
C2 and C5/C6 use per-example differentiable cosine-soft head alignment; C5 recomputes conditional maps from non-sink scores before alignment and C6 aligns binary sink/rest outcomes only.
C3 is post-softmax head-mean cell MSE; S3 C2/C3 have distinct fixed-index JSD/MSE IDs and require equal native head counts.
C4 uses own-width sqrt relation scaling, causal QQ/KK/VV, diagonal support, q>=1 rows, R=64 by default and a fixed denominator across chunks.

Calibration measures accumulated full-effective-batch gradients on exactly 16 identified training-only batches with seed 1729, unchanged initialization and dropout disabled; it does not provide production factors.

numerical_parity.fixture: deterministic CPU FP32 tensors, two examples with right padding and unequal 3/2 or equal 2/2 native heads
other_verified: shifted CE and full-vocabulary KD forward/gradient match independent token-loop references
all teacher outputs are detached and all intended student gradients are finite
C5 original sink-score direct gradient is exactly zero in the fixture and loss is invariant under +1000 sink-score perturbation
C6 non-sink probability direct gradients are zero, fixed-sink-mass redistribution is invariant and changing sink mass changes loss
S1 C2 is student-head permutation invariant; S3 fixed-index C2 is sensitive to the same permutation
finite differences support C2 attention-score and REL projected-value gradients
calibration ratios use the accumulated full-batch gradient, restore modes, parameter gradients and RNG, and reject invalid panels/degenerate gradients
